mapper.select: select id, model_name, model_version, model_type, source_path, training_task_id, metrics_mAP, metrics_speed, status, remark, create_time, update_time from seer.model_registry order by status desc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into seer.model_registry (model_name, model_version, model_type, source_path, training_task_id, metrics_mAP, metrics_speed, status, remark, create_time) values (#{modelName}, #{modelVersion}, #{modelType}, #{sourcePath}, #{trainingTaskId}, #{metricsMap}, #{metricsSpeed}, #{status}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.update: update seer.model_registry set model_name = #{modelName}, model_version = #{modelVersion}, model_type = #{modelType}, source_path = #{sourcePath}, training_task_id = #{trainingTaskId}, metrics_mAP = #{metricsMap}, metrics_speed = #{metricsSpeed}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select #{dirPath} as dir_path, f.file_name, concat(#{dirPath}, '\\', f.file_name) as full_path from (select 'best.pt' as file_name union select 'last.pt') f where not exists ( select 1 from seer.model_registry m where m.source_path = concat(#{dirPath}, '\\', f.file_name) )
mapper.update: update seer.model_registry set status = 'archived' where status = 'in_use'
update seer.model_registry set status = 'in_use', update_time = now() where id = #{id}
